changes: Normalizes Latin diacritics and common non-decomposing Latin letters for safe title matching while preserving the canonical TMDB/library title unchanged.
Automation and Interactive Search Newznab queries use an accent-folded compatibility title, so canonical titles such as 90 Day Fiancé search release naming such as 90 Day Fiance.
The same accent-insensitive normalization is used by local release safety matching, scoring, filesystem reconciliation, and Smart Import title identity checks.
Preserves NewzDeck v3.6.22 All Posts binary resolution/recovery and all earlier SAB, Downloads, Automation, Smart Import, Discover/TMDB, and Windows runtime behavior.
regression_guards: 90 Day Fiancé must safely match 90.Day.Fiance.SxxExx release names without changing the stored/displayed title.
Pokémon must match Pokemon and Beyoncé must match Beyonce.
Silo must still not match the release-group token EPSILON; accent folding must not reintroduce arbitrary substring matching.
S.W.A.T. and 9-1-1 stylized/acrostic matching behavior remains preserved.
Movie year safety checks remain unchanged after title matching.
NewzDeck v3.6.22 unresolved/obfuscated binary behavior and v3.6.20 authoritative SAB Queue/History behavior remain unchanged.
name: Accent-Insensitive Automation Search
